description: Scrape a single page and return its content in the requested formats, with options for main-content extraction, waiting, and page actions.

actions.description: Browser actions to perform before scraping, as Firecrawl action objects.

blockAds.description: When true, block ads and popups while scraping the page.

excludeTags.description: HTML tags to exclude from the scraped output.

formats.description: Output formats to return for the scraped page, e.g. markdown or html.

includeTags.description: HTML tags to include in the scraped output; when set, only content in these tags is returned.

onlyMainContent.description: When true, return only the page's main content, excluding navigation and other boilerplate.

proxy.description: Proxy mode to use for the scrape request, as accepted by the Firecrawl API.

timeout.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the scrape.

url.description: URL of the single page to scrape.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait for the page to settle before scraping.

name: firecrawl_scrape
